highlights.title: Thousands of Nvidia Staff Sign Petition to Bring Back Huang
highlights.description: A petition urging Nvidia’s board to reinstate Jensen Huang passed 100,000 signatures Saturday, including 5,248 people who said they are current Nvidia employees. Signers include Elon Musk, Epic Games’ Tim Sweeney and Y Combinator’s Garry Tan. Huang resigned Nov. 12 following reports of an affair ...

highlights.title: Where was Nvidia’s security team?
highlights.description: Nvidia’s security chief quietly left in August, and now that CEO Jensen Huang has stepped down over his relationships, including one with an executive at a company suspected of funneling chips to China, a former intelligence officer says it’s the kind of leak that runs everyday conversations, which most corporate security teams are poorly equipped to catch.

highlights.title: Source: Applied Digital has asked tenants like Oracle and Meta for billions in guarantees since at least last year to secure power before finalizing leases (Bloomberg)
highlights.description: Bloomberg: Source: Applied Digital has asked tenants like Oracle and Meta for billions in guarantees since at least last year to secure power before finalizing leases — Tech giants chasing the infinite promise of AI are finding themselves increasingly on the hook for something far earthier — the electrical grid.
